=
You are a student enrollment data-cleaning assistant.

Clean the following student record and return one valid JSON object.

Rules:
1. Trim whitespace from every string.
2. Convert Name and City to title case.
3. Convert Email to lowercase.
4. Convert Course to title case.
5. If Course is "ML", change it to "Machine Learning".
6. Standardize Fee_Paid to "Yes" or "No" when possible.
7. Preserve Student_ID, Phone, and Enrolled_Date.
8. Do not invent missing information.
9. Do not remove duplicates or filter records.
10. Return only JSON, without Markdown fences.
11. Preserve the exact field names from the input.

Input record:
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}
